questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। d sinθ=mλ এবং |sinθ|≤1⇒|m|≤d/λ=(9)। grazing-order m=(9) geometrically allowed (θ=90°)।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: x(t)=6t³−2t²+t। t=1-এ acceleration কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Velocity=3nt²−4t+1; acceleration=6nt−4। t=1-এ 6×(6)−4; দুবার derivative লাগে।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: SHM period 32 s। positive extreme থেকে প্রথম equilibrium পৌঁছাতে সময় কত s?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Extreme→equilibrium phase change π/2, full cycle 2π। তাই time T/4=(8) s।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Single slit width 6μm, wavelength 0.5μm। first minimum-এর sinθ কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Single slit dark minima a sinθ=mλ। first m=1⇒sinθ=0.5/(6)=1/(2×(6))।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: a=(10,4,0) এবং unit b=(3/5,4/5,0)। b-direction-এ a-এর scalar projection কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Scalar projection a·b̂=(10)×(3/5)+4(4/5)=(3×(10)+16)/5; b ইতিমধ্যে unit।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Chargedcapacitor Cvoltage 10 V connectsparallelidenticalunchargedC,batteryabsent। final total energy/initial energy কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। ChargeconservationQ=Cn,final Ceq2C,Vfinal=(10)/2。 Ufinal=½·2C((10)/2)²=¼Cn²;Uinitial½Cn²⇒ratio½।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: SameY,AwireslengthL ও 2Lseries,F=9N। longwireextension/shortwireextension কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Serieswirestensionsame। extensionFL/(AY)∝length⇒longtwice; parallelextensionequal এখানেপ্রযোজ্যনয়।
questions.book_reference: পদার্থের গাঠনিক ধর্ম · HSC PCM পাঠ্যক্রম
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: R₀=5Ω at0°C, α=0.004°C⁻¹। at50°C R কত Ω?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। R=R₀(1+αΔT)=(5)×(1+0.2)=1.2×(5)। coefficient dimension ব্যবহার করতে হয়।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Emission rest wavelength 500nm, observed 550nm। redshift z কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। z=(λobs−λrest)/λrest=10×(5)/500=(5)/50। denominator rest wavelength, observed নয়।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Star A apparent magnitude 7, B magnitude 12। flux FA/FB কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Pogson relation magnitude difference 5 corresponds flux ratio 100। Smaller magnitude brighter⇒A has100×B flux।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: V=πr²h। r-এর maximum relative error 11%, h-এর 2%। V-এর first-order maximum error কত %?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Product-এর maximum relative errors যোগ হয়, powers multiplier: ΔV/V≈2Δr/r+Δh/h=(2×(11)+2)%।
questions.book_reference: ভৌতজগৎ ও পরিমাপ · HSC PCM পাঠ্যক্রম
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Ideal Atwood mass 3 kg ও 9 kg,g10। rope tension কত N?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। a=g/2=5। lightmassT−mg=ma⇒T=(3)×(10+5)=15nN। tensionheavierweight নয়।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: AC mains frequency 10 Hz। ideal full-wave rectified ripple fundamental frequency কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Full wave-এ positive ও negative half-cycle দুটোই same polarity। period T/2; ripple frequency 2f।
questions.book_reference: সেমিকন্ডাক্টর ও ইলেকট্রনিক্স · HSC PCM পাঠ্যক্রম
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: P-V rectangle cycle pressure 2P→5P, volume V→3 V; clockwise। PV=4 J। net work কত J?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Cycle work enclosed area ΔPΔV=(3P)(2 V)=6PV=6×(4) J। clockwise positive work by gas।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Circular satellite-এর speed 10 m/s। force-এর instantaneous power কত W?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Gravity radial এবং velocity tangential, তাই F·v=0। force কাজ না করেও velocity direction বদলায়।
questions.book_reference: মহাকর্ষ ও অভিকর্ষ · HSC PCM পাঠ্যক্রম

questions.question_bn: Weak monoprotic acid-strong base titration equivalence at25°C-এ pH সাধারণত কেন 7-এর বেশি?
questions.explanation: Equivalence-এ weak acid-এর conjugate base A⁻ থাকে; A⁻+H₂O⇌HA+OH⁻ basic solution দেয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=3D make 120°। net dipole কত D?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Vector resultant 2μcos60°=μ=nD। linear 180°-এ zero; dipoles scalar যোগ নয়।
questions.book_reference: পর্যায়বৃত্ত ধর্ম ও রাসায়নিক বন্ধন · HSC PCM পাঠ্যক্রম
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: van der Waals gas n=10 mol,b=0.04L/mol,V=10L। available volume V−nb কত L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Excluded volume correction nb=0.04nL। available V−nb=(10)−0.04×(10)=0.96nL; attraction term আলাদা।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: M²⁺+2e⁻→M(s),25°C। ion concentration 10⁻14M। E−E° কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Q=1/[M²⁺]=10ⁿ, solidsactivity 1। Nernstshift−0.0592×(14)/2=−0.0296nV; dilution reduction potential কমায়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Mono alkene C11H22 completely burn।1 mol hydrocarbon থেকে CO₂:H₂O mole ratio কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Products nCO₂+nH₂O; carbon (11) ও hydrogen 2×(11) balanced। mole ratio 1:1, oxygen consumption 3×(11)/2 আলাদা।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Food wet mass 170g,dry mass 136g। wet-basis moisture content কত %?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। Wet-basis moisture=(wet−dry)/wet×100=2×(17)/(10×(17))×100=20%; dry-basis হলে 25%।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Weak monoprotic HA concentration 0.10M, Ka=225×10⁻⁸। x≪C। [H⁺] approx কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Ka≈x²/C⇒x=√(KaC)=√((15)²×10⁻⁹)=(15)×10⁻⁴⋅⁵। stated approximation check x/C ছোট থাকতে হবে।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Sample 20 mol diene (2C=C per molecule), complete Br₂ addition। Br₂ mole required কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 20। প্রতি C=C one Br₂ addition করে। two double bonds per molecule⇒2Br₂ per molecule; total 2×(20) mol।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Fe₂O₃+3CO→2Fe+3CO₂। Fe₂O₃amount 8 mol complete conversion। CO₂mol কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Balanced reaction 1Fe₂O₃gives 3CO₂। stoichiometric mole factor 3; iron yield 2nalternateseparateproduct।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Water Ca²⁺ 11mmol। soap RCOO⁻ stoichiometric precipitate Ca(RCOO)₂ হলে soap anion কত mmol consumed?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Charge-balanced salt requires 2monovalent carboxylate per Ca²⁺। nmmol Ca consumes 2×(11) mmolsoap।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: l=28 subshell-এ magnetic quantum number mₗ কতটি value নিতে পারে?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 28। mₗ=−l,…,0,…,+l মোট 2l+1 value। spin multiplicity orbital count-এ multiply করা হয় না।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Acyclic alkane C4H10 complete combustion-এ 1 mol fuel-এর O₂ requirement কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। CₙH₂ₙ₊₂→nCO₂+((4)+1)H₂O। oxygen atoms 3×(4)+1⇒O₂=(3×(4)+1)/2 mol; water oxygen ও ধরতে হয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Wet food 100 kg moisture 40%w/w। সব water remove, dry solid unchanged। dry mass কত kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 20। Dry fraction 1−0.4=0.6। conserved nonvolatile dry solid=5×(20)·0.6=3×(20) kg; water removed 2×(20)।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ore30g contains 80%Fe₂O₃। complete Feproduction, MFe₂O₃160,MFe56। iron mass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Pure oxide 8ng; Femassfraction 112/160=0.7。 actual iron 8×(3)·0.7=5.6ng; impurityremovedfirst।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: κ=7×10⁻³S/cm,C=0.10 mol/L। Λm কত S·cm²/mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Λm=1000κ/C withcM,κS/cm。1000·(7)10⁻³/0.10=10×(7); L→cm³factor 1000。
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Identical straight-chain alkyl halide with 4carbon undergoes ideal Wurtz coupling। major coupled alkane carbon count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Wurtz 2RX+2Na→R–R+2NaX। identical alkyl fragments eachncarbon combine to2ncarbon; mixed halides mixtures দেয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 52mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 13mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 13। HClconsumed=4×(13)−(13)=3nmmol। CaCO₃+2HCl uses 2acidpercarbonate; CaCO₃=1.5nmmol।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 0.1M HCl 6 mL ও 0.1M NaOH 3 mL mix; additive volume। final[H⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Initial H⁺0.2×(3) mmol, OH⁻0.1×(3) mmol; excess 0.1×(3) mmol,total 3×(3) mL। concentration 0.1/3=1/30M।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: N₂+3H₂→2NH₃। initial N₂=8 mol,H₂=16 mol। maximumNH₃ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। H₂limiting:reactionextent=(2×(8))/3,availableN₂(8) larger। NH₃=2extent=4×(8)/3 mol; balanced coefficients essential।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl Ksp=1×10⁻¹⁰। Na Cl solution [Cl⁻]=19×10⁻²M, Ag Cl saturated; s≪[Cl⁻]। [Ag⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 19। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((19)×10⁻²)=(1/(19))×10⁻⁸M।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: H₂SO₄0.10M,160 mL পুরো neutralise করতে NaOH 0.20M কত mL?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। Acidmoles 0.1·10nmmol=nmmol,base 2nmmol লাগে। V=2×(16)/0.2=10nmL; acid capacity 2explicit।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 900 mL0.20MNaOH; MNaOH 40g/mol। solutemass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Volume 0.1nL,moles 0.20·0.1×(9)=0.02×(9)। massmoles×40=0.8ng; mL→Lconversion দরকার।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: CH₄combustionreleases 890kJ/mol; amount 24 mol,burnerefficiency 80%। useful heat কত kJ?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 24। Totalcombustionheat 890nkJ। useful fraction 0.8⇒712nkJ; heatrelease sign separate from positive useful amount।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Gas molar mass 80g/mol, P1atm,T300 K,R=0.082L·atm/(mol·K)। density কত g/L?
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=22, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Energy difference Z²(1/2²−1/3²)=Z²(1/4−1/9)=5Z²/36। emission energy positive।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Metalfeed 280 kg,smeltingyield 80%,purification recovery 90%। final metal কত kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 28। Sequential recovery multiply 0.8×0.9=0.72।10nkgfeed→7.2nkg; percentageyieldsadd নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: At25°C,[OH⁻]=21×10⁻³M strong base। pH কোনটি?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 21। pOH=3−logn, pH=14−pOH=11+logn। water temperature 25°C থেকে p Kw14 ব্যবহার।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ozone decomposition 2O₃→3O₂। 18 mol ozone fully decomposes। total gas mole increase কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। FinalO₂=(3/2)(18)। initial gas (18), increase=(3/2)(18)−(18)=(18)/2; final mole ও increment আলাদা।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Bleach sample 30 mol OCl⁻ acidic iodometry-তে I₂ কত mol মুক্ত করে? OCl⁻+2I⁻+2H⁺→I₂+Cl⁻+H₂O
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 30। Balanced reaction অনুযায়ী OCl⁻:I₂=1:1। iodide coefficient 2 হলেও iodine molecules (30) mol; redox electron balance 2।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ideal gas P2atm,V=36.900000000000006L,T300 K,R0.082। amount কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। (3)=PV/(RT)=2·12.3×(3)/(0.082·300)=24.6×(3)/24.6=(3) mol; no extra Avogadro multiplication।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: CathodereductionE°=22/10 V,anodereductionE°=−0.20 V। E°cell কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Ecell=Ecathode(reduction)−Eanode(reduction)=(22)/10−(−0.2)=((22)+2)/10 V; addoppositesigns।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 22×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Mixing doubles total volume, each ion concentration (22)×10⁻⁴/2। Qsp=((22)²/4)×10⁻⁸; তারপর Ksp তুলনা করে precipitation।
questions.subject: Chemistry
